questions.question: What exact current V3 API/type/port admits an immutable PSEPF-derived prior alongside ResolvedStructuralContext?
questions.known_boundary: R02 proposes V3EmpiricalPossibilityInput as a thin reference/lifecycle envelope; EPV3 located no current production port at the exact R03 base.
questions.must_not_assume: That PSEPF may be passed through the structural ContextResolver or directly inserted into ActorCausalState.

questions.question: Which V3 transition authorities, if any, may consult PSEPF geometry and for what exact use classes?
questions.known_boundary: Existing V3 authorities own mutation domains independently; EPV3 found no blanket prior-to-state mapping authority.
questions.must_not_assume: That all V3 transitions may read the field or that field mass is a transition probability.

questions.question: What exact V3_EMPIRICAL_POSSIBILITY_METABOLISM_AUTHORITY identity/version/hash governs use of a field?
questions.known_boundary: R02 names the authority slot but does not define the metabolism algorithm.
questions.must_not_assume: A placeholder/default metabolism or direct modal sampling.

questions.question: What event or decision boundary determines PSEPF projection/admission timing: generation, phase boundary, causal decision, explicit request, or another governed trigger?
questions.known_boundary: ADP-021 provides an event-driven scheduler and CAN-007 provides a structural-prior refresh precedent, but neither creates PSEPF cadence authority.
questions.must_not_assume: Annual polling, every-turn refresh, one-time lifetime validity or hidden latest.

questions.question: Which objective actor facts comprise the comparator snapshot, who owns their currentness, and what exact snapshot hash binds them to one PSEPF request?
questions.known_boundary: ADP-007 forbids demographic/structural inputs from becoming psyche and contains zero generic initial-domain fact rules; generated facts require exact owners.
questions.must_not_assume: That survey-coordinate names are generated actor facts or that missing actor facts may be filled from population prevalence.

questions.question: What exact staleness predicate invalidates a previously admitted PSEPF field after actor facts, effective time, source applicability, target request or authority version changes?
questions.known_boundary: R02 requires current/stale/refresh-required/invalidated/unavailable state. CAN-007 proves a distinct structural two-channel refresh pattern but does not automatically govern PSEPF.
questions.must_not_assume: Immutability of a PSEPF object implies perpetual V3 admissibility.

questions.question: Who owns PSEPF refresh/requery and how is a refresh request linked to the prior intake without rewriting causal history?
questions.known_boundary: R02 says refresh-required returns upstream to comparator/query/field production; V3-side lifecycle must remain separate from empirical recomputation semantics.
questions.must_not_assume: That V3 mutates PSEPF or that refresh itself is a causal event.

questions.question: What exact replay/intake receipt binds actor snapshot, PSEPF refs, V3 use class, effective time, metabolism authority and negative state?
questions.known_boundary: R02 requires exact replay/intake identity; V3 event/replay authorities already require content/provenance-bound parentage.
questions.must_not_assume: That an upstream ReplayReceipt is itself the causal prior or sufficient V3 intake receipt.

questions.question: How are NO_COMPARATOR, AMBIGUOUS_COMPARATOR, ZERO_SUPPORT, LOW_SUPPORT, TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE, FIELD_STALE_REFRESH_REQUIRED and METABOLISM_AUTHORITY_MISSING represented at the V3 intake seam?
questions.known_boundary: R02 freezes these as distinct negative/availability states and forbids fallback invention.
questions.must_not_assume: Nearest comparator, default belief, modal response or silent null coercion.

questions.question: How is same PSEPF + same ResolvedStructuralContext proven compatible with divergent lawful actor histories and developed states?
questions.known_boundary: Existing V3 event/history/relationship/memory/epistemic ownership makes divergence semantically possible; R03E requires explicit hostile proof.
questions.must_not_assume: Same priors imply same actor trajectory or same belief state.

questions.question: Does V2/application need any new field solely because PSEPF becomes a V3 prior?
questions.known_boundary: Current V2 law consumes actor-safe V3 truth and opaque provenance only; direct PSEPF/structural behavioral authority is denied.
questions.must_not_assume: A prompt/persona field containing empirical geometry, comparator labels, source disagreement or population rank.

questions.question: If V2/app receives opaque provenance for a V3 state affected by PSEPF, what exact V3-owned provenance envelope prevents behavioral dereference of the upstream prior?
questions.known_boundary: V2 may carry opaque V558 provenance refs but may not dereference structural priors for behavior/persona. No current PSEPF-specific V2 provenance contract was located.
questions.must_not_assume: That PSEPF geometry or comparator receipt is actor-accessible or prompt-visible.

questions.question: Where is the complete current production V3/V2 runtime implementation corresponding to the accepted authority contracts?
questions.known_boundary: Accepted ADP-017/ADP-021 findings report no top-level current production V3/V2 tree; current V558 gate/governance code is superseded terrain; W3 P1-P3 are bounded fixture packets.
questions.must_not_assume: That accepted architecture or fixture packet law equals deployed production implementation.

questions.question: Which exact production tests must prove the second prior cannot mutate identity, history, memory, knowledge, belief, relationship or V2 expression without an owning V3 transition?
questions.known_boundary: W3 fixture law already requires rejection-zero-mutation, replay, stale-parent and structural-context-not-psyche tests; a PSEPF-specific extension is not yet current.
questions.must_not_assume: Schema separation alone proves semantic noncollapse.
